description: This file defines a HeadingHandler class for managing Markdown heading spans within a text editor component, utilizing the Markwon library to handle heading levels 1 through 6, configuring persisted spans, and applying spans during markdown rendering.

classes.name: HeadingHandler
classes.description: A class that handles the application and persistence of heading spans in markdown editing, supporting heading levels 1 through 6.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the HeadingHandler with a Markwon instance, extracting its theme configuration.

methods.name: configurePersistedSpans
methods.description: Configures which heading span classes are persisted in the Spannable, associating each with its theme.

methods.name: handleMarkdownSpan
methods.description: Handles applying the correct heading span to a segment of markdown text during rendering, based on heading level.

methods.name: markdownSpanType
methods.description: Returns the class type of the markdown span this handler processes, i.e., HeadingSpan.
